strings.STARTUP_TAGLINE: THE FIRST LIGHT OF AN INTERSTELLAR AGE
strings.STARTUP_DEV_HELP:
F12 captures the screen. Export diagnostics from the pause menu.

Open the Developer Game launcher, then choose New Game > Sandbox. The footer shows DEV MODE. Saves stay separate.

Manual launch: --dev-game enters developer mode directly. Ctrl+Shift+F12 toggles mode only in a --devtools launch.
strings.STARTUP_CHOOSE_HINT: Select how your civilization's journey will begin.
strings.STARTUP_STORY_DESC: A guided narrative with authored characters, conflicts and discoveries.
strings.STARTUP_SANDBOX_DESC: Set the galaxy scale, rivals, ancient empires, and your people.
strings.STARTUP_TIP_PAUSE: Tip: Space pauses or resumes time.
strings.STARTUP_TIP_RAIL: Tip: Use the navigation rail to open research, construction, fleets, and relations.
strings.STARTUP_TIP_SURVEY: Tip: Survey nearby systems before sending civilian expeditions.
strings.STARTUP_TIP_SAVE: Tip: Save before changing a major plan.

strings.SETUP_REPRODUCTION_HINT: Reproduction requires the same seed and generation settings.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_TYPE_HINT: Choose the shape of your civilization’s new home.
strings.SETUP_POPULATION_HINT: Choose its stellar age and activity. Galaxy shape and population are independent.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_SPIRAL_DESC: Sweeping arms around a bright central bulge.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_BARRED_DESC: Spiral arms extend from an elongated central bar.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_ELLIPTICAL_DESC: A broad body dominated by older stellar populations.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_LENTICULAR_DESC: A smooth disk and bulge with little spiral structure.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_IRREGULAR_DESC: Asymmetric structure and patchy stellar nurseries.
strings.SETUP_GALAXY_RING_DESC: A distinct ring surrounds a sparse interior.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_DETERMINED: Population state is determined from the galaxy seed and morphology. The same settings always give the same result.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_INTENSE: Intense star formation. More young massive stars, supergiants and Wolf-Rayet stars, with stronger stellar hazards.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_ONGOING: Strong ongoing star formation with elevated young, massive stellar populations.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_BALANCED: A balanced mixture of stellar ages with moderate ongoing star formation.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_REDUCED: Reduced star formation, with a greater relative presence of older stars and stellar remnants.
strings.SETUP_POPSTATE_MINIMAL: Very little current star formation. Older, long-lived stars and remnants dominate.
